summary: This directory serves as the root orchestration point for the project, providing a unified public interface for analyzing, scoring, and modeling project directory and package structures to generate actionable metadata.
responsibilities: Expose core analytical functionality to external consumers
Aggregate package and directory analysis capabilities
Provide entry points for project structural evaluation
relationships: The directory serves as a central hub that re-exports functionality from specialized internal modules for package and directory analysis.
Internal modules work together to convert raw filesystem data into structured metadata and analytical scores.
designDecisions: Use of central export patterns to simplify consumption
Modular separation of analytical logic from data structures
Public API surface defined by aggregate exports
